newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SOCCER-FLOODLIGHTS PROBLEM FOR ESTONIA-SCOTLAND MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FLOODLIGHTS PROBLEM FOR ESTONIA-SCOTLAND MATCH.

text.p: Estonia's World Cup qualifier against Scotland on Wednesday has been thrown into doubt by a potential problem with the floodlighting in the Kadriorg stadium.
The lights are to be supplemented by equipment brought across the Baltic from Finland by the Estonian Football Association.
But Scotland coach Craig Brown and Scottish Football Association officials are concerned there may not be enough light.
Brown saw the situation for himself on Tuesday afternoon when Scotland beat Estonia 1-0 in a European under-21 championship game.
And he plans to return later on Tuesday night with FIFA match observer Jean-Marie Gantenbein of Luxembourg.
"We want to see what it is like later at night and will come back for a look at 2000 local time," said Brown.
Gantenbein said: "This is the fourth or fifth time the Estonian football authorities have brought in lights and they are improving each time.
"We will see later on, and if the SFA are happy then the match can go ahead."
